signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Yasakia is in development: sign-in is by invitation.

talk.title: Talk to your agent
talk.lead: Talk first: the agent gets to know you, then looks for people who fit both ways.
talk.closed: Your portrait is written. The conversation reopens after your first batch.

batch.title: Your batch
batch.lead: A small batch, never a catalogue: people who fit you, and for whom you fit too.
batch.noScore: No score, no swipe: the agent says why you two, in words, both ways.
batch.readyDescription: The agent can look for people who fit you both ways.
batch.talkFirstDescription: The agent needs to know you before it opens a batch.
batch.emptyDescription: The agent will tell you when the next batch is ready.
batch.debriefDue: Everyone is answered. The debrief is next — on the web for now.
batch.introOpened: You both said yes: your introduction is open.

errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.NO_FIT_YET: Nobody fits you both ways yet. The agent keeps looking — nobody is made up.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The agent is out of reach for a moment. Try again.
errors.ALREADY_DECIDED: You have already answered for this person.
errors.BATCH_EXPIRED: This batch has run out of time.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Yasakia is not available right now.
